name: Orbit · 单圆屏触摸家居看板

runtime.desktop: Wayland with GTK layer-shell (Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm/labwc)

notes: Native Python GTK/Cairo renderer; no WebKit, browser, local HTTP server, pip or Node is required.
Square canvas >=360x360 at scale 1 and normal transform; size alone is not an SKU compatibility guarantee.
Touch event counters are observations; verify the physical panel and input positions.
Legacy web preview remains separate and is not launched by ./app.

tested_configurations.system: Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm aarch64, labwc/Wayland
tested_configurations.result: Native drawing/window binding confirmed by runtime; user confirmed complete image, step buttons and dial drag.
tested_configurations.scope: One tested panel configuration; does not certify all sizes, live HA or all devices.
